tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:670: def _planted_rows(n_tok, n_layer, topk, n_exp):
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:671:     """Even tokens repeat t-1's set exactly (history structure); odd tokens
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:672:     replace half the members with guaranteed-fresh successors (markov
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:673:     structure: prev member -> its fresh successor). |ids| stays topk."""
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:674:     rows = []
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:675:     prev_sets = [set() for _ in range(n_layer)]
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:676:     for t in range(n_tok):
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:677:         for L in range(n_layer):
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:678:             if t < 10:
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:679:                 ids = {(L * 11 + 3 * d) % n_exp for d in range(topk)}
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:680:             elif t % 2 == 0:
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:681:                 ids = set(prev_sets[L])
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:682:             else:
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:683:                 prev = prev_sets[L]
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:684:                 keep = set(sorted(prev)[: topk // 2])
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:685:                 ids = set(keep)
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:686:                 nxt = (max(prev) + 1) % n_exp
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:687:                 while len(ids) < topk:
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:688:                     if nxt not in ids:
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:689:                         ids.add(nxt)
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:690:                     nxt = (nxt + 1) % n_exp
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:691:             prev_sets[L] = ids
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:692:             rows.append((t, L, frozenset(ids)))
tools\predictor-screen-gplr.py:693:     return rows

tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:7: (n_rows_reused == 0 in all 96 rounds). The contract reasons from K=4 (12.5%
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:8: of a bank resident) and the 8 GB shape's K=2, so the recorded split verdict
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:9: is a K=0 verdict.
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:10: 
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:11: This session runs the depth arms that were missing, on the CURRENT binary,
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:12: in ONE with-gpu-lock hold, plus a same-binary K=0 reference:
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:13: 
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:14:   K0   row-set reactive, cache OFF, split OFF   (same-binary identity ref)
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:15:   K2   cache K=2, split OFF
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:16:   K4   cache K=4, split OFF
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:17:   K2S  cache K=2 + --experts-host 2             (the contract's shape)
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:18:   K4S  cache K=4 + --experts-host 2             (the contract's shape)
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:19:   K0b  repeat of K0                             (drift bracket, same binary)
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:20: 
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:21: Why the split picture can change with depth: ls_plan_split() sends a row to
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:22: the host ONLY when its state is PENDING (issued, copy not complete);
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:23: READY rows always execute on the device. With the cache ON a large share of
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:24: demanded rows are already READY, so --experts-host N caps a smaller
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:25: host-eligible pool and the realised host share is expected to FALL below the
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:26: K=0 value. That interaction is the point of the S arms, not an anomaly.
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:27: 
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:28: Session name gplr62-kdepth: every artifact carries that prefix, so no
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:29: recorded T-GPLR-61 / T-GPLR-19 evidence is overwritten. No claim is made
tools\run-gplr62-kdepth.py:30: here; the runner only records what happened.
